review.scope: Independent raw-sample arithmetic and record review, with shared pinned host and clock validators. Model/runtime integrity was verified by the collector; the separate audit did not rehash those large assets. Agent review is not external validation.

handoff.scope: A prospective operational clarification during session 1 added bounded, owned assertion overlap across session handoffs. Frozen method, native schedule, rest periods and checks were unchanged. Same-boot checkpoint transfer verified the actual gaps. Release markers were authenticated by the execution owner; observed releases and closure were within the bound. These auxiliary durations are not performance samples.

conditions.background: Docker was stopped. Other user/system activity and light source/document work continued; no other model, build, test or benchmark job ran during collection.
conditions.order: Backend order is linked to round: KleidiAI first in round 1, CPU first in round 2. Consecutive sessions are not independent replications.

restoration.earlier_verification: The first check found a stale worker heartbeat. A later fresh idle heartbeat appeared without service changes; the same checks then passed. The earlier failed check is retained.
restoration.limits: Recorded configuration, mount metadata and health only; not identical process memory or data-volume contents.

reproduction: Public benchmark collection/reporting used the pinned execution revision. Raw records, local review notes and the private setup controller remain local; their hashes do not supply missing files. The public setup workflow is being completed separately. Earlier v2/v3 studies remain separate and are not pooled.
